family_reports.body: Life has never been the same. The injustice is heavy
It has taken mine and my childs life away from us. It has put my daughter Hracie in more danger. It has violated our constitutional rights while giving our abuser more power.
Family court has shown me that children and families come last. They have facilitated and enabled conflict that has cost me and my daughter years and tens of thousands of dollars.
